pandas.Series.to_hdf

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import tables

with TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    path = Path(folder) / "demo.h5"
    data = pd.Series([2, 5], name="units")
    data.to_hdf(path, key="orders")
    print(pd.read_hdf(path, "orders"))
